rightPlace.title: You're in the right place if…
items: Your last event was "fine," and you want more than just fine.
You want to build momentum or raise more money for your cause.
You'd like people to feel excited and energized about your mission.
You want a creative lead who handles it start to finish.
rightPlace.imageAlt: An audience on its feet, cheering, clapping, and filming the stage

items.a: Pricing generally ranges from $2,000 to $5,000 depending on the complexity of the event. Event emcee services start at $500/event, and can range depending on the scope of duties. A 50% deposit reserves your date and starts creative work; the remaining 50% is due at the conclusion of the engagement.
If your venue has a suitable setup, there's no equipment charge. If not, rental and delivery are quoted separately and added only with your approval before booking.
Yes. Travel outside the Birmingham area is discussed and approved in advance.

items.q: How far ahead should we book?
items.a: As soon as you know when you’d like to hold your event or launch your campaign.

items.q: How big a group can you handle?
items.a: Group size depends on the size and accommodations of the venue selected for the event.

closing.title: Not sure what fits?
closing.body: Tell us about your goals. We'll figure out the best approach to help you exceed them.
